verdict.rationale: Apple's first-party macOS pages directly describe this story: when a Mac and an iPhone or iPad are near each other, they 'automatically pass what you're doing from one device to another' (macos-docs-4). Supporting continuity features include Universal Clipboard copy/paste across devices (macos-docs-5, macos-docs-21) and picking up a Siri AI conversation on the Mac where you left off on the iPhone (macos-docs-29). Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of which apps and tasks support handoff and the pairing or setup requirements, and independent hands-on corroboration that it works reliably.
